titulo: Me writing the list instead of doing it
caption:
Me writing the list instead of doing it

Me writing the list instead of doing it.

Six sticky notes, zero things done, and a feeling of progress that is only ink.

Next time: pick the smallest one and do it before the next note.

#Cella #procrastination

Closer to yourself.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left. Sticky notes pop onto the wall one by one, reading email, call, fix, reply, buy and plan, and each time the figure's eyes turn happy and it gives a little pulse. After the sixth note its eyes go wide, then it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me writing the list instead of doing it.
